Educational flat-design concept map — mind map illustration, square 1:1 format. Italian middle school textbook (scuola secondaria I grado), DigComp I level. Central hub: large rounded rectangle "🏗️ Smart city e tecnologie per la città intelligente", solid fill #BF360C, white bold sans-serif label, subtle drop shadow. Five branch clusters radiate from the hub with smooth curved lines. Each branch has a colored pill label and 2–5 smaller rounded child nodes:
  • INNESCA [#5E35B1]: "Smart city e tecnologie per…"
  • ESPLORA [#1565C0]: "Lo studente descrive le tecnologie smart…" | "uso di tecnologie digitali per ottimizzare i servizi urbani" | "semafori intelligenti" | "raccolta rifiuti ottimizzata"
  • SPERIMENTA [#E65100]: "ciclo idrologico / water cycle (hydrological cycle)" | "acquedotto / aqueduct / water supply network"
  • AGISCI [#00695C]: "Progetta una soluzione smart per un problema reale…" | "traffico all'uscita, rifiuti abbandonati, illuminazione carente)" | "Professione futura: Urban Planner Sostenibile"
  • RIPASSA [#F57F17]: "smart city" | "IoT" | "tecnologia urbana" | "privacy" | "ciclo idrologico"
Style rules: white background, all labels in Italian, branch nodes solid fill (branch color) with white text, hub accent stripe #BF360C on bottom edge only, connecting lines 2px curved matching branch color, no photographs, no decorative frames, no gradients, clean radial balanced layout, Inter/Nunito-style sans-serif typography, WCAG AA contrast, flat vector illustration, 1:1 square.
